data.narrative:
Evolv Technology operates in Defense & Security, a sector populated by 17 comparable companies spanning public and private stages. The peer set includes 2 public comps (trading under DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, anchored by Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. Valuations across the cohort range from $300M to $4.5B, reflecting material stage and market position variance.

The peer-median method provides the primary valuation anchor. The median valuation across the 17-company cohort is $1.4B, derived from same-sector and similar-valuation-tier peers. Sample public and late-stage comparables include Chaos Industries at $4.5B (Series D), Skydio at $4.4B (Series F), and Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series C), while earlier-stage peers including Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B) and Neros ($2.5B, Series C) anchor the lower range. This methodological approach yielded an implied valuation of $1.4B.

Triangulation across applicable methods supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median of $1.4B. Evolv's current market valuation of $1.04B sits modestly below this peer-derived median, a $360M delta attributable to stage positioning, capital deployment trajectory (the company has raised $400M+), and relative revenue maturity versus the peer median. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate relative to peers and the continued relevance of Defense & Security comparables as the sector consolidates.
